**`lib/content-type.js`**
- The parameter regex value alternative now tries a full quoted-string before falling back to the token form:
  ```js
  /(?:^|;)\s*([\w!#$%&'*+.^`|~-]+)=(?:"((?:[\t \x21\x23-\x5b\x5d-\x7e\x80-\xff]|\\[\t \x21-\x7e\x80-\xff])*)"(?=\s*(?:;|$))|([^;]*))/gm

  The body uses the RFC 9110 §5.6.4 qdtext / quoted-pair ranges, so `;` and `key=value` inside a quoted value are consumed as part of the value. - `toString()` re-escapes `"` and `\` as quoted-pairs.
